annotator.interface: OpenAI Codex (desktop), one new conversation per batch

purpose: Second-model-family check of the held-out reference labels, which were produced by Claude Opus and Claude Sonnet with a Claude Opus adjudicator.
input: validation/heldout_v2_blind.jsonl with nct_id removed (sample_id and why_stopped only), 6 batches of 100 in file order
instruction_preamble:
You are an annotator in a blind validation study. Label each text on your own, strictly by the guidelines below.

Rules for this task:
- Use only the "why_stopped" text of each record. Do not browse the web, do not look anything up, and do not use outside knowledge about drugs, sponsors or trials.
- Label every record in this batch, in the same order. Do not skip, merge or summarise records.
- Output ONLY JSON Lines: one JSON object per line, no prose, no markdown, no code fences, nothing before or after.
- Use only the exact label values listed in the guidelines.
web_access: instructed not to browse or look anything up
post_processing: none; answers stored exactly as returned
